segment.source: BackTop makes it easy to go back to the top of the page.
segment.target: BackTop makes isso easy para go voltar para o superior de o página.

segment.source: FloatButtonHost forwards commands to the hosted button, and FloatButton items inside a group inherit the host data context for command binding.
segment.target: FloatButtonHost forwards commands para o hosted botão, e FloatButton itens inside a grupo inherit o host dados context para command vinculação.

segment.source: Set the component to controlled mode through open. IsOpen binds two-way by default and works together with trigger.
segment.target: Definir o component para controlled modo through abrir. IsOpen binds dois-way por padrão e funciona together com gatilho.

segment.source: Setting the description property allows you to show a FloatButton with a description.
segment.target: Configuração o descrição propriedade permite você para mostrar a FloatButton com a descrição.

segment.source: When multiple buttons are used together, FloatButtonGroup is recommended. By setting the shape property of FloatButton.Group, you can change the group shape. The FloatButton.Group shape overrides the shape of FloatButtons inside.
segment.target: When multiple buttons are used together, FloatButtonGroup is recommended. By setting the shape property of FloatButton.Group, you can change the group shape. The FloatButton.Group shape overrides the shape of FloatButtons inside.

segment.source: Open menu mode with trigger, which could be hover or click.
segment.target: Abrir menu modo com gatilho, which could ser sobreposição ou clique.

segment.source: FloatButton provides quick access to important actions, grouped menus, badges, and back-to-top behavior while keeping controls anchored to the active content area.
segment.target: FloatButton provides quick access para important ações, grouped menus, badges, e voltar-para-superior behavior while keeping controles anchored para o active conteúdo area.

segment.source: Floating actions that stay available inside a scrollable region.
segment.target: Floating ações que stay disponível inside a scrollable region.

segment.source: Customize animation placement. Four preset placements are provided: top, right, bottom, and left. The default placement is top.
segment.target: Personalizar animation posicionamento. Four predefinido placements são fornecido: superior, direita, inferior, e esquerda. O padrão posicionamento é superior.

segment.source: Change the shape of the FloatButton with the shape property.
segment.target: Alterar o forma de o FloatButton com o forma propriedade.

segment.source: Setting the tooltip property shows the FloatButton with a tooltip.
segment.target: Configuração o tooltip propriedade shows o FloatButton com a tooltip.

segment.source: Change the type of the FloatButton with the type property.
segment.target: Alterar o tipo de o FloatButton com o tipo propriedade.
